svg.title: Nobody can name the gate their build is waiting on.
svg.desc: YaVaKa maps the 19-stage Zimbabwe build sequence and names each statutory gate, its authority and what it blocks.
svg.text: Council plans, cession, EMA, ZINWA, ZESA, inspections.
Each one has an authority, a document and a stage it holds up.
Blocks superstructure. Chased, not waited on.
“If nobody can name it, nobody can chase it.”
